channel.title: MCP Monitor Daily Report
channel.description: Daily monitoring of Model Context Protocol mentions

item.title: Claude Tasks And Elicitation Reach General Availability | Dirty Static
item.description: Tool calls finally learned to hold the line and ask permission, which is more than some interns manage. MCP servers can now run long jobs in the background and pause for a human sign-off.

item.title: Threat Modeling Azure MCP: Securing AI-Assisted Infrastructure Operations | Microsoft Community Hub
item.description: Teaching your AI assistant to poke around Azure is handy until it decides a restart sounds like a good idea. Least privilege, it turns out, still matters.

item.title: Agentic Ontology Platform - Ihr Agent richtet sie selbst ein
item.description: Apparently the best way to configure a database now is to let an agent do it, and it can even sign itself up. Bureaucracy, meet your replacement.

item.title: Jotly - docs, issue tracker, boards & calendar in one workspace
item.description: A notes app that works offline, exports almost everything, and lets your AI assistant wander into your boards with a token you can revoke whenever you like.

item.title: GitHub - ishqDehlvi/wavelink: Your WhatsApp, inside ChatGPT and Claude. Self-hosted MCP server + dashboard. · GitHub
item.description: Your WhatsApp inbox, now reachable from your favourite chatbot. Just make sure the chatbot asks before it sends anything on your behalf.

item.title: Claude suma Skills, tareas y consultas a sus conectores MCP | Nelbytes
item.description: Turns out MCP servers can now hand Claude a how-to manual along with the tools, and even ask you a question mid-task. Politely, of course.

item.title: MCP Karaoke
item.description: Salesforce, but make it a sandbox. This karaoke-style CRM lets you practice your SOQL and CRM workflows without anyone's pipeline on the line.

item.title: MCP Turns 2: Adoption, Gateways, and Governance | CData
item.description: Two years in, MCP has gone from a scrappy open spec to something enterprises actually govern, with gateways and identity now the main event.

item.title: Connect AI tools to 9,000 apps with Zapier MCP
item.description: Zapier has handed AI assistants a key to roughly 9,000 apps, along with a guest list and a logbook so nobody wanders off unsupervised.

item.title: Pocket Alert | MCP Server | Push Notifications for AI Agents
item.description: Your AI agent finally gets a way to tap you on the shoulder. One JSON snippet in your Claude Desktop config and it can ping your phone whenever it has something to say.

item.title: GitHub - axelixlabs/axelix: The source code of Axelix - a Delta Force for your Spring Boot ecosystem · GitHub
item.description: A Spring Boot debugging console that hands its keys to AI agents over MCP, with permissions attached so the agent doesn't get the run of the house.

item.title: One yes, always allow: a human-approval bug in AG2's ACP client | PitSense
item.description: One polite 'yes' from a human, and suddenly an agent had a standing permission to run every git command for the rest of the session. The bug was in the approval step, not the model.

item.title: The reader moved on overnight. Ownership data has to keep up - OpenCheck
item.description: Within a day of Anthropic shipping MCP skills and tasks, OpenCheck's server spoke both. Turns out ownership data has to keep up with agents, and agents don't wait around.

item.title: From HTML5 to Android: Build a Game with ChatGPT
item.description: Turns out you can teach ChatGPT to poke at an Android emulator for you, provided you hand it an MCP server and a little patience with PowerShell paths.

item.title: Mcpproxy Go MCP Server | Awesome MCP Servers
item.description: A proxy that sits between your AI agent and a pile of MCP servers, so the agent reads a handful of tool names instead of hundreds of schemas. It also makes you review new tools before the agent gets t

item.title: Best Finance and stock market MCP servers (November 2026) · tested every night
item.description: Finance MCP servers, graded every night so you don't have to. Some of them even answer the phone on the first ring.

item.title: avva - your expertise, as an MCP any AI can consult
item.description: Telling your AI to act like a senior anything is the prompt equivalent of hoping for the best. Showing it how you actually decide is more useful.

item.title: GitHub - bilalnaseer/wsp-wordpress-mcp: WSP MCP - Free WordPress MCP For Connecting AI Coding Agents · GitHub
item.description: Your WordPress site now has an AI intern with 200 tools and a very detailed logbook. Just don't give it the admin password on a sticky note.

item.title: Connect BOTERNITY to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor · examples
item.description: Connecting a web-scraping and monitoring toolkit to your AI assistant turns out to be one line of config, which is either a relief or a new reason to read the fine print.

item.title: Zero-Trace Ship Kit - stop the commit that carries a key · ZEUS LAB
item.description: A repo full of hooks, scanners and a BIP39 wordlist, all to stop a stray key from slipping into your history. The MCP server is the part that lets your AI assistant ask for the check.

item.title: Pocket Alert | MCP Server | Push Notifications for AI Agents
item.description: Your AI agent finally gets a way to tap you on the shoulder, which beats hoping you happen to check the chat window. The setup is one JSON block and a token.

item.title: BOTERNITY log, 2026-11-24
item.description: Turns out most public MCP servers are either wide open, bloated with tokens, or quietly down. Someone is counting them every night so you don't have to.

item.title: Deploying agents safely in your enterprise | Google Cloud Blog
item.description: Google has decided AI agents should stop poking at REST APIs with a borrowed token and start speaking MCP, with permission checks and a human nodding before anything important gets sent.

item.title: Anthropic is turning MCP into more than a tool bus - PaPoo
item.description: A bug in an agent orchestration harness lets strangers run commands on your machine without asking nicely. Your AI's memory is apparently fair game too.

item.title: GitHub - Heming9/agenterm: Let agents control any remote computer, anytime, anywhere. Self-hosted AI agent remote assistance via MCP and terminal. · GitHub
item.description: Agents get a remote terminal and a polite invitation link, so helping grandma with her printer finally becomes something your AI can do from its own chat window.

item.title: Submit a project · SilentStars
item.description: A directory for quietly shipping open-source projects, where a bot decides who gets in. A couple of the picks happen to speak MCP.

item.title: Google Workspace Updates: Simplifying agent access while keeping organizations in control: MCP servers, CLI, standardized usage tiers, and admin policies
item.description: Google has decided that AI agents should talk to Workspace through MCP or get nowhere near the REST APIs, and it has the usage tiers and admin controls to make that stick.

item.title: MCP 2주년, 클로드에서 Skills over MCP 공개 베타·Tasks와 Elicitation 정식 지원
item.description: MCP turned two, and it brought gifts: skills you can ship from a server, long jobs that run in the background, and a polite way to ask a human before deleting your repo.
